current_mcc = 5812
new_mcc = 5411
merchant_name = "Martinis_Fine_Steakhouse"

info = get_merchant_info(merchant_name)
capture_delay_str = capture_delay_bucket(info['capture_delay'])
account_type = info['account_type']

print(f"New MCC: {new_mcc}")
print(f"Account type: {account_type}")
print(f"Capture delay: {capture_delay_str}")

total_fees_current_mcc = 0.0
total_fees_new_mcc = 0.0

# Process each month
for month in sorted(unique_months):
    month = int(month)
    
    # Get monthly stats for the current merchant
    stats = monthly_merchant_stats(payments, merchant_name, 2023, month)
    
    # Get only the transactions for this merchant in this month
    month_txns = stats['transactions']
    
    if len(month_txns) == 0:
        continue
    
    monthly_fraud_level = stats['monthly_fraud_level_bucket']
    monthly_volume = stats['monthly_volume_bucket']
    
    # Calculate fees with current MCC
    fees_current = total_fees_paid(
        fees, 
        month_txns,
        account_type=account_type,
        mcc=current_mcc,
        capture_delay=capture_delay_str,
        monthly_fraud_level=monthly_fraud_level,
        monthly_volume=monthly_volume
    )
    month_total_current = sum(fees_current.values())
    
    # Calculate fees with new MCC
    fees_new = total_fees_paid(
        fees,
        month_txns,
        account_type=account_type,
        mcc=new_mcc,
        capture_delay=capture_delay_str,
        monthly_fraud_level=monthly_fraud_level,
        monthly_volume=monthly_volume
    )
    month_total_new = sum(fees_new.values())
    
    print(f"\nMonth {month}:")
    print(f"  Transactions: {len(month_txns)}")
    print(f"  Fees with MCC {current_mcc}: €{month_total_current:.2f}")
    print(f"  Fees with MCC {new_mcc}: €{month_total_new:.2f}")
    print(f"  Delta: €{month_total_new - month_total_current:.2f}")
    
    total_fees_current_mcc += month_total_current
    total_fees_new_mcc += month_total_new

print(f"\n{'='*50}")
print(f"YEAR 2023 TOTALS:")
print(f"Total fees with MCC {current_mcc}: €{total_fees_current_mcc:.2f}")
print(f"Total fees with MCC {new_mcc}: €{total_fees_new_mcc:.2f}")
print(f"Delta (new - current): €{total_fees_new_mcc - total_fees_current_mcc:.6f}")
